header.speaker: ARTHUR BROOKS
header.notes: Kit test: rebuild the V5 decisions through the kit pipeline.

lines.text: There are three macronutrients to the happiest life.
lines.plan: Hook on the face with the opening zoom. Styled phrase THREE / macronutrients.

lines.text: The happiest people have enjoyment, satisfaction, and meaning.
lines.plan: Three paper objects in a row (bloom, staircase, compass) with labels Enjoyment, Satisfaction, Meaning. Each arrives on its word.

lines.text: Now, that's important because it means you need to enjoy your life
lines.plan: Full, text-centric: ENJOY / your life. plates (Inter 800 + Playfair italic on sage), paper bloom below, rises on "enjoy". Chapter tag 01 / ENJOYMENT.

lines.text: and you need to know the difference between enjoyment and pleasure,
lines.plan: Graphic-centric card: Enjoyment ≠ Pleasure. Enjoyment arrives on its word, the ≠ draws, Pleasure on its word.

lines.text: I mean, the pursuit of pleasure is not the secret to happiness.
lines.plan: Half, text-centric: "Pleasure" in Playfair; on "not" a line strikes through a small "happiness" below it.
Punchline on the face. Styled to / REHAB. Music dips.

lines.text: The satisfaction, which is the joy of an accomplishment or an activity after struggle.
lines.plan: Full, graphic-centric: paper staircase from Struggle (bottom left) to Accomplishment flag (top right). Chapter tag 02 / SATISFACTION.

lines.text: And last but not least is meaning.
lines.plan: Half on ink: chapter tag 03 / MEANING and the paper compass, needle settles on "meaning".
Full on ink, text-centric: "Your why." large Playfair italic.

lines.text: The happiest people have a bead on those three things
and they pursue those three things really, really actively.
lines.plan: Close on the face. Styled REALLY, REALLY / actively.
